method: Studio MCP upload_image over a local http.server on 127.0.0.1:8647 serving this directory (build package P6, ADR-0020 R8 rung 3)
note: This art belongs to a CONTROL, not to a theme package: `package` is null on purpose. A control paints through the public UI.Image primitive, which has no slice geometry and no tint, so there is no sliceBorder column here — gauge_face.png is horizontally invariant instead (asserted by the generator) and the other two are drawn at a fixed px box.

gauge_face.role: the carved channel the needle rides in
gauge_face.drawnAt: width = fill, height = gauge:dial.height (stretched horizontally, losslessly)

gauge_needle.role: the value token — tapered brass needle with a ruby boss

gauge_endcap.role: fluted brass end cap, used unflipped at both ends
